why_best: Steering optical clarity across dynamic spatial planes creates a tangible physical depth that effortlessly directs developer attention to the critical metric.
why_bad: A standard graphic wipe or flat opacity fade destroys the illusion of three-dimensional space, turning an immersive optical moment into a generic presentation slide.
trap: A near-miss will stall the continuous forward camera motion when the visual transfer completes, killing the scene's spatial momentum before the beat finishes.
